```{r load }
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

data_2017_2021 <- read_csv("~/Documents/Data Science/Machine Learning/data_2017_2021.csv")
data_2022_2023 <- read_csv("~/Documents/Data Science/Machine Learning/data_2022_2023.csv")

head(data_2017_2021)
head(data_2022_2023)

glimpse(data_2017_2021)
glimpse(data_2022_2023)

colnames(data_2017_2021)
colnames(data_2022_2023)


# new  complete data base & standarization
df <- bind_rows(data_2017_2021, data_2022_2023)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(year = str_extract(Date, "\\d{4}$"))
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Apparatus = toupper(Apparatus))
df <- df %>%
  mutate(Apparatus = ifelse(Apparatus == "UE", "UB", Apparatus))

# number of rows
nrow(df)

# columns
colnames(df)

# years
table(df$year)

# competitions
length(unique(df$Competition))

# events (apparatus)
unique(df$Apparatus)

# gender
table(df$Gender)

# Check df
class(df)
dim(df)

```
```{r clean}
# ============================================================
# 0. RESET & LOAD LIBRARIES
# ============================================================


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(stringi)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)


select <- dplyr::select 
filter <- dplyr::filter

# ============================================================
# 1. STANDARDIZATION & ASCII CLEANING
# ============================================================
df_clean <- df %>%
 dplyr::mutate(
    # Remove accents/special chars (Essential for matching dictionaries)
    FirstName = stri_trans_general(str_trim(FirstName), "Latin-ASCII"),
    LastName  = stri_trans_general(str_trim(LastName), "Latin-ASCII"),
    Country   = str_to_upper(str_trim(Country)),
    
    # Standardize apparatus for the ML model
    Apparatus = case_when(
      Apparatus %in% c("FX", "FLOOR") ~ "FX",
      Apparatus %in% c("PH", "POMMEL") ~ "PH",
      Apparatus %in% c("SR", "RINGS") ~ "SR",
      Apparatus %in% c("PB", "PBARS") ~ "PB",
      Apparatus %in% c("HB", "HBAR") ~ "HB",
      Apparatus %in% c("BB", "BEAM") ~ "BB",
      Apparatus %in% c("UB", "BARS") ~ "UB",
      TRUE ~ Apparatus
    )
  )

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = str_to_upper(str_trim(Gender)),  
    Gender = case_when(
      Gender %in% c("W", "F", "WOMEN", "WOMAN", "FEMALE", "WAG") ~ "WAG",
      Gender %in% c("M", "MEN", "MAN", "MALE", "MAG") ~ "MAG",
      TRUE ~ Gender
    )
  )

# ============================================================
# 2. DICTIONARIES
# ============================================================
name_dict <- tibble(
  raw = c(
    "Ellie", "Matt", "Mathew", "Samual", "Sam",
    "Ga",
    "Mohamad", "Shanté",
    "Hansa", "Rakah",
    "Noémie", "Dimitrijs",
    "Sasiwimion", "Dmitry",
    "Fred", "Léo",
    "Jann", "Jin-Seong","Valentin"
  ),
  clean = c(
    "Elisabeth", "Matthew", "Matthew", "Samuel", "Samuel",
    "Garam",
    "Mohamed", "Shante",
    "Hansha", "Rakan",
    "Noemie", "Dimitrijs",
    "Sasiwimon", "Dmitriy",
    "Frederick", "Leo",
    "Jan", "Jinseong","Valentina"
  )
)

name_exceptions <- tibble(
  LastName = c("Chuaisom", "Akhmejanov"),
  FirstName_correct = c("Weerapat", "Emil")
)

lastname_dict <- tibble(
  raw = c("Damato", "Morz", "Sant"),
  clean = c("Damato", "Morz", "Santos")
)

prefixes <- c("de", "del", "dos", "da", "van", "von", "di", "la", "le", "das", "mc")

# ============================================================
# 3. NAME DICTIONARY MATCHING (Safe Join)
# ============================================================
# We use distinct() to prevent duplicating rows during the join
name_dict_safe <- name_dict %>% distinct(raw, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  left_join(name_dict_safe, by = c("FirstName" = "raw")) %>%
  mutate(FirstName = coalesce(clean, FirstName)) %>%
  select(-clean)


# ============================================================
# 4. FULL CLEAN PIPELINE
# ============================================================
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  
  # ----------------------------
  # FIRST NAME CLEANING
  # ----------------------------
  mutate(
    FirstName = str_trim(FirstName),
    FirstName = str_extract(FirstName, "^[^- ]+")
  ) %>%
  
  # ----------------------------
  # FIRST NAME DICTIONARY
  # ----------------------------
  left_join(name_dict, by = c("FirstName" = "raw")) %>%
  mutate(
    FirstName = if_else(is.na(clean), FirstName, clean)
  ) %>%
  select(-clean) %>%
  
  # ----------------------------
  # SPECIAL CASES
  # ----------------------------
  left_join(name_exceptions, by = "LastName") %>%
  mutate(
    FirstName = if_else(
      FirstName == LastName & !is.na(FirstName_correct),
      FirstName_correct,
      FirstName
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-FirstName_correct) %>%
  
  # ----------------------------
  # LAST NAME CLEANING
  # ----------------------------
  mutate(
    LastName = str_trim(LastName),
    LastName = stri_trans_general(LastName, "Latin-ASCII"),
    
    # Fix special patterns
    LastName = str_replace_all(LastName, "^D[’' ]", "D"),
    LastName = str_replace_all(LastName, "^Mc\\s+", "Mc"),
    
    parts = str_split(LastName, " "),
    
    LastName = map_chr(parts, function(x) {
      if (length(x) == 1) {
        x
      } else if (tolower(x[1]) %in% prefixes) {
        paste(x[1], x[2])
      } else {
        x[1]
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  select(-parts) %>%
  
  # ----------------------------
  # LAST NAME DICTIONARY
  # ----------------------------
  left_join(lastname_dict, by = c("LastName" = "raw")) %>%
  mutate(
    LastName = if_else(is.na(clean), LastName, clean)
  ) %>%
  select(-clean) %>%
  
  # ----------------------------
  # FILL MISSING FIRST NAME
  # ----------------------------
  group_by(LastName, Country) %>%
  mutate(
    FirstName = if_else(
      is.na(FirstName) & any(!is.na(FirstName)),
      FirstName[!is.na(FirstName)][1],
      FirstName
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ============================================================
# 5. ATHLETE ID CREATION
# ============================================================
# This is the "Group" variable for your Python GroupKFold
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(athlete_id = paste(FirstName, LastName, Country, sep = "_"))


# ============================================================
# 6. VALIDATION CHECK
# ============================================================

name_check <- df_clean %>%
  count(FirstName, LastName, Country, sort = TRUE)

df_clean %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Country, LastName)

# ============================================================
# 7. Date Validation - Competition Date Ranges
# ============================================================

library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Keep original
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Date_raw = as.character(Date),
    Date_raw = str_squish(Date_raw),
    Date_raw = str_replace_all(Date_raw, "Sept", "Sep"),
    Date_raw = str_replace(Date_raw, "^0 Sep 2023", "30 Sep 2023")
  )

# Create start date text from different date range formats
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Date_start_text = case_when(
      
      # Example: 29 Oct 2022 - 6 Nov 2022
      str_detect(Date_raw, "^\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}\\s+-\\s+\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$") ~
        str_extract(Date_raw, "^\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}"),
      
      # Example: 11-16 Apr 2023
      str_detect(Date_raw, "^\\d{1,2}-\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$") ~
        paste(
          str_extract(Date_raw, "^\\d{1,2}"),
          str_extract(Date_raw, "[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$")
        ),
      
      # Example: 29 Jul-2 Aug 2022
      str_detect(Date_raw, "^\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+-\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+\\s+\\d{4}$") ~
        paste(
          str_extract(Date_raw, "^\\d{1,2}\\s+[A-Za-z]+"),
          str_extract(Date_raw, "\\d{4}$")
        ),
      
      # If it is already a single date
      TRUE ~ Date_raw
    )
  )

# Parse the start date
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Date_clean = parse_date_time(
      Date_start_text,
      orders = c(
        "a d b Y",   # SUN 25 JUL 2021
        "d-b-y",     # 25-Jul-21
        "d-b-Y",     # 25-Jul-2021
        "d b Y",     # 25 Jul 2021
        "d B Y",     # 25 July 2021
        "Y-m-d",     # 2021-07-25
        "m/d/Y",     # 07/25/2021
        "d/m/Y"      # 25/07/2021
      ),
      locale = "C"
    )
  )

# Replace Date with cleaned version
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date_clean))

# Extract Year + Month safely
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = month(Date),
    YearMonth = Year * 100 + Month
  )

# ============================================================
# Checks
# ============================================================

class(df_clean$Date)
sum(is.na(df_clean$Date))      # should be LOW or 0
table(df_clean$Year, useNA = "ifany")

# ============================================================
# 8. FIX VAULT (PROTECTIVE VERSION)
# ============================================================

# 1. Identify ALL vault rows
all_vaults <- df_clean %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Apparatus, "^VT"))

# 2. Separate the specialists (VT1/VT2) and calculate their average
vt_specialists <- all_vaults %>%
  filter(Apparatus %in% c("VT1", "VT2")) %>%
  group_by(athlete_id, Country, Gender, Date, Competition, Round) %>%
  summarise(
    # Keep the max score or average? Usually, for ML, the average of the two is best
    Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    D_Score = max(D_Score, na.rm = TRUE), # Best difficulty shown
    E_Score = mean(E_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Carry over other metadata
    FirstName = first(FirstName),
    LastName = first(LastName),
    Year = first(Year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Apparatus = "VT", n_vaults = 2)

# 3. Identify the All-Arounders (single "VT" entries)
# We exclude anyone we already processed in the specialist group
vt_aa <- all_vaults %>%
  filter(Apparatus == "VT") %>%
  anti_join(vt_specialists, by = c("athlete_id", "Date", "Round")) %>%
  mutate(n_vaults = 1)

# 4. Recombine and Replace
vt_final <- bind_rows(vt_specialists, vt_aa)

# 5. Final Dataset Assembly
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Apparatus, "^VT")) %>% # Remove all messy vault rows
  bind_rows(vt_final)                      # Add the clean, merged vault rows


athlete_review <- df_clean %>%
  arrange(athlete_id, Date, Competition, Round, Apparatus) %>%
  select(
    athlete_id,
    FirstName,
    LastName,
    Country,
    Gender,
    Date,
    Year,
    Competition,
    Round,
    Apparatus,
    Score,
    D_Score,
    E_Score
  )

View(athlete_review)

```

```{r pivots}
date_missing_summary <- df_clean %>%
  summarise(
    total_rows = n(),
    missing_Date_raw = sum(is.na(Date_raw) | Date_raw == ""),
    missing_Date_clean = sum(is.na(Date)),
    pct_missing_Date = round(mean(is.na(Date)) * 100, 2),
    missing_Year = sum(is.na(Year)),
    pct_missing_Year = round(mean(is.na(Year)) * 100, 2)
  )

date_missing_summary

failed_date_formats <- df_clean %>%
  filter(is.na(Date) & !is.na(Date_raw) & Date_raw != "") %>%
  count(Date_raw, sort = TRUE)

View(failed_date_formats)
```

```{r pivots}

#  Number of gymnast per meet
df_pivot_number_gymnast <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Competition, Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gymnasts = n_distinct(paste(FirstName, LastName)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# number of gymnast per country per event
df_pivot2_gymnast_per_event_per_country <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Country, Apparatus, Competition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gymnasts = n_distinct(paste(FirstName, LastName)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# type of round per meet
pivot_table_round_permeet <- df_clean %>%
  count(Competition, Year, Round) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Round,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Year, Competition)


# meets per year
meets_per_year <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_meets = n_distinct(Competition),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# countries per year
countries_per_year <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_countries = n_distinct(Country),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# athletes per year
athletes_per_year <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    num_athletes = n_distinct(paste(FirstName, LastName)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
## pvot wider
df_pivot_wide <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Country, Apparatus) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gymnasts = n_distinct(paste(FirstName, LastName)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Apparatus,
    values_from = n_gymnasts,
    values_fill = 0
  )%>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(-Country))) %>%
  arrange(desc(total))


df_pivot_country_year_gender <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Year, Country, Gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_gymnasts = n_distinct(paste(FirstName, LastName)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

olympic <- df_clean %>%
  filter(Competition == "Olympic Games") %>%
  select(Year, Competition, Gender, Round, Apparatus) %>%
  distinct()

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1. THE FINAL RESCUE
df_final <- df_clean %>%
  # Steal year from competition name ONLY if Year is still missing
  mutate(Year = ifelse(is.na(Year), 
                       as.numeric(str_extract(Competition, "\\d{4}")), 
                       Year)) %>%
  # Filter out any rows that absolutely cannot be dated (should be 0 now)
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  # Standardize all Apparatus names one last time to be safe
  mutate(Apparatus = toupper(trimws(Apparatus)))

# 2. THE QUALITY CHECK
cat("Final Dataset Breakdown:\n")
print(table(df_final$Year, useNA = "always"))

# 3. WRITE THE MASTER FILE
write.csv(df_final, "gymnastics_ml_ready.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nFile saved: gymnastics_ml_ready.csv is ready for Python.")
```
